content.short: Arkis provides institutional portfolio margin across CeFi, DeFi and TradFi venues.
content.description: Arkis offers institutional credit with portfolio margin computed across centralised, decentralised and traditional venues at once, so collateral posted in one place supports exposure in another. Fragmented margin is a genuine cost for funds operating across venues, since capital sits idle against positions that partially offset each other.
content.meta: Arkis provides institutional portfolio margin and credit across CeFi, DeFi and TradFi venues.
